wilds.note: 寻风地带 (第十章 A; 剧情总纲 §3 第十章 ①, §6 岚城卡): up from the mirror's chamber in 天驼关's 石林 (fantasy1.c's upper way, 上道迷香之味不止, whose dream/tmp.c was only 整修中) a narrow, steep way of polished yellow stone in incense and mist (幻影道) comes out on a high field under low cloud (风口); north of it a forest of wind-worn white pillars (石林雾野) where trails part for three sheltered hollows (west, north, east), the 逆灵宫's black altar at the downwind west edge (卜风坛) and the 兵部's dead camp on the east (兵部旧营). The wind blows out of the town along one of three routes (game/data/lancheng/world.json winds); its points are the spawn points lancheng.wind.*.

street.note: 白石街 (第十章 B; 剧情总纲 §3 第十章 ②, §6 岚城卡: 白石街、风铃、雾): where the wind stops, the town — the 白石门 on the island's south lip, the mist below it; a white-stone street climbing north in two bends between round-shouldered white houses with bells under every eave; the 铃匠's open workshop on a terrace west of the first bend, the empty 萧家 yard east of the second; the street's top terrace before the 风铃阁's door (a map of its own).

pavilion.note: 风铃阁 (第十章 B; 剧情总纲 §3 第十章 ③, §1 底线二「岚城风铃阁」): a tall timber hall at the street's top, a thousand small bells hung from its beams; along the north wall the 十铃架, ten great bells each cut with a place's name — the ones where someone trusts you ring and shine (layout stage props by the trust marks, 计划 §4); 岚翁 under them; a quiet room east with his cushion and his books. A narrow stair by the west wall up to the 云台 (第十章 C).

terrace.note: 云台 (第十章 C; 剧情总纲 §3 第十章 ④): out on top of the 风铃阁, a white stone deck hung over the cloud sea with no rail; far below the mountains slip slowly back (the town moving on the wind). In its north middle the whirlwind with 旋芒 turning in it (a layout stage prop until the sword has its hand); the cloud's edge east, where the wind puts one down at 天驼关's mirror (乘风).
